note: Pinned Temurin (Eclipse Adoptium) build for linux. Every field here is fixed; the fetch verifies the archive's SHA-256 against the checksum below before it is unpacked. To update: read the release from https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/<major>/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=linux&vendor=eclipse (and the same with architecture=aarch64), then replace release_name, java_version and each arch's url/sha256/size with the new release's package link, checksum and size. Never point this at a mutable 'latest' URL.
